Pet Travel Guidance for Aurelia Skyways

This article explains the main steps for moving a companion animal with Aurelia Skyways from booking through pickup. The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the process clear, checks welfare needs, and helps you prepare the right documents and carrier.

Start by sharing basic travel details as soon as you can. That gives the team room to review your pet's comfort needs and match the trip to the route. If your plans change, send an update promptly so the record stays accurate and the handoff stays smooth.

At the terminal, follow staff direction and keep your animal calm and contained. A welfare coordinator will look at comfort factors and may suggest a quieter waiting area, a carrier check, or a brief pause before boarding. Keep labels readable and make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and easy to carry.

<<FACT F002>> Keep your contact details current so the team can reach you if anything shifts during the trip. If you are traveling with a companion animal for the first time, bring any required paperwork in an easy-to-access folder and arrive prepared to review it.

After arrival, stay available until pickup is complete and confirm that all items are returned. <<FACT F021>> If your pet needs extra support during the journey, tell the desk early so the plan can be adjusted with care. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the Aurelia Skyways service channels.
